headline: The Frederick County school board voted to ban AI for students in every grade.
score_reason: Pool 5; official board vote read in the local paper; no change.
importance_line: Students in every grade of the Frederick County schools can no longer use AI under the new rule, which affects students and teachers first, and the doubt is that the report gives no detail on how the ban will be applied.
summary: The Frederick News-Post reports that the Frederick County school board voted 6 to 1 on Wednesday, 7 Oct 2026, to ban AI for students in all grades after hearing from teachers. Aubrey Lynch, a teacher at Urbana High School, had argued at the meeting for a full ban, and the report does not say how the rule will be enforced.
